about.ch1Title: The right people change what research can tell you.
about.ch1Desc: XFact Research connects research questions with the people, experiences and context needed to answer them. Our focus is thoughtful recruitment, clear execution and evidence that teams can use.
about.ch2Title: A good study starts before the first question.
about.ch2P1: An interview guide cannot compensate for the wrong audience. A survey cannot explain a market without understanding its context. Useful research begins with defining whose perspective matters and creating a way for those people to participate.
about.ch2Highlight: Find the right people. Ask with purpose. Listen with context.
about.ch2P2: That is the role XFact is built to play: connect research teams with relevant participants and coordinate the work that turns a plan into a meaningful study.
about.ch3Title: North America and Latin America, in the same conversation.
about.ch3P1: Our work connects research teams with people across North America and Latin America. Remote coordination and local knowledge bring each study closer to its audience.
about.ch3P2: Healthcare, finance, education and consumer products ask different questions. The common thread is respect for the people behind the answers and clarity about how the research will be delivered.
about.ch4P1: Technology can help organize recruitment, fieldwork and analysis. It earns its place when it improves the experience for participants and the quality of the work.
about.ch4P2: We define the audience, methods, communication and deliverables around the project. The aim is straightforward: research teams should know what is happening, why it matters and what comes next.
about.diffTitle: Clear Scope. Relevant Participants. Useful Delivery.
about.diff1: Recruitment aligned with the study audience and screening criteria
about.diff2: Fieldwork plans adapted to the market and research method
about.diff3: Patient, provider, business and consumer perspectives
about.diff4: Language and cultural context considered from the start
about.diff5: Clear updates, responsibilities and delivery expectations
about.diff6: Project-specific consent, confidentiality and privacy requirements

about.cred3Desc: North American and Latin American perspectives connected through New York and São Paulo.
about.cred4Desc: Audience, methods, milestones and deliverables agreed around your research goals.
about.ctaTitle: What do you need to understand?
about.ctaDesc: Tell us about your audience and research question. We will discuss a practical route from recruitment to delivery.

howWeWork.d1Desc: Project coverage spans North and Latin America, with local audience and language needs defined in the research plan.
howWeWork.d2Desc: Data collection, consent, access and retention requirements are scoped for each project, including HIPAA, LGPD and GDPR where applicable.
howWeWork.d3Desc: Screening criteria, fieldwork checks and deliverable expectations are agreed around the research objectives.

mixed.title: The numbers. The context. The full picture.
mixed.desc: Combine qualitative depth with quantitative reach. We connect conversations, surveys and fieldwork in one research plan, helping your team understand both what happens and why.
mixed.approachDesc: We start with your decision and choose the sequence that fits it. Qualitative exploration can shape a survey, quantitative findings can guide interviews, or both streams can run together. The findings come together in one clear synthesis.
mixed.body1: Interviews, focus groups and observation uncover language, motivations and questions worth investigating.
mixed.body2: Surveys and structured data collection examine how widely those patterns appear across the audience.
mixed.body3: We compare both streams, investigate differences and build a coherent interpretation for your next decision.
mixed.whenDesc: Use Mixed Methods for patient journeys, product discovery, fintech UX and audience segmentation when a single method cannot answer the whole question.

mixed.body1: 通过访谈、焦点小组和观察发现动机与关键问题。
mixed.body2: 通过问卷和结构化数据收集检验规律在受众中的普遍程度。
mixed.body3: 比较两类研究结果，分析差异，形成完整的解释。
mixed.whenDesc: 适用于患者旅程、金融科技用户体验、产品探索与受众细分。

mixed.title: The numbers. The context. The full picture.
mixed.desc: Combine qualitative depth with quantitative reach. We connect conversations, surveys and fieldwork in one research plan, helping your team understand both what happens and why.
mixed.approachDesc: We start with your decision and choose the sequence that fits it. Qualitative exploration can shape a survey, quantitative findings can guide interviews, or both streams can run together. The findings come together in one clear synthesis.
mixed.body1: Interviews, focus groups and observation uncover language, motivations and questions worth investigating.
mixed.body2: Surveys and structured data collection examine how widely those patterns appear across the audience.
mixed.body3: We compare both streams, investigate differences and build a coherent interpretation for your next decision.
mixed.whenDesc: Use Mixed Methods for patient journeys, product discovery, fintech UX and audience segmentation when a single method cannot answer the whole question.

about.ch1Title: The right people change what research can tell you.
about.ch1Desc: XFact Research connects research questions with the people, experiences and context needed to answer them. Our focus is thoughtful recruitment, clear execution and evidence that teams can use.
about.ch2Title: A good study starts before the first question.
about.ch2P1: An interview guide cannot compensate for the wrong audience. A survey cannot explain a market without understanding its context. Useful research begins with defining whose perspective matters and creating a way for those people to participate.
about.ch2Highlight: Find the right people. Ask with purpose. Listen with context.
about.ch2P2: That is the role XFact is built to play: connect research teams with relevant participants and coordinate the work that turns a plan into a meaningful study.
about.ch3Title: North America and Latin America, in the same conversation.
about.ch3P1: Our work connects research teams with people across North America and Latin America. Remote coordination and local knowledge bring each study closer to its audience.
about.ch3P2: Healthcare, finance, education and consumer products ask different questions. The common thread is respect for the people behind the answers and clarity about how the research will be delivered.
about.ch4P1: Technology can help organize recruitment, fieldwork and analysis. It earns its place when it improves the experience for participants and the quality of the work.
about.ch4P2: We define the audience, methods, communication and deliverables around the project. The aim is straightforward: research teams should know what is happening, why it matters and what comes next.
